summary: Paperclip contains no FDA review documents (Summary Review, Medical Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader, Division Director memo, or Risk review) for BLA125559 (Praluent/alirocumab) — only approval letters and labeling were available. The original Orig1s000 approval letter (fda_3231c6cb) does not mention any advisory committee, and no passage in the available documents either describes an AdComm meeting or states that one was not convened. Based solely on the documents available in paperclip, no advisory committee record could be established (adcom_held set to false; evidence: none found).
